release_notes.title: Practice Bots and a Better First Battle
release_notes.summary: Practice against bots, learn the basics with a guided tutorial, and enjoy clearer account and leaderboard controls.

sections.title: New
items: Practice vs Bot adds Easy, Medium and Hard opponents for Live and Rounds Duel. Use your chosen race and loadout against a Dawnforged bot with matching talent point budgets. Practice grants no XP or rating.
New players can try a guided Survival tutorial, followed by an introduction to PvP sends and income. Replay it from Settings.
Meltdown Line Wars has a new silver and blue game icon. The launcher keeps its familiar orange icon.

sections.title: Balance
items: Successfully sent enemies now return 50% of their purchase price after completing their route, rounded down. Cancelled sends retain their existing refunds.
Ranked winners can receive XP when an opponent surrenders after a genuine match. The quitter receives no XP; rating changes remain separate.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Hub leaderboards use race emblems, whole-number scores and a more compact centered layout. Casual and Ranked choices have clearer icons.
Password recovery gives clearer sending and confirmation messages, including a reminder to check spam.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Selected profile avatars restore correctly between sessions.
Inviting a friend to a party creates the party automatically when needed.

sections.title: Known issues
items: Practice bots currently play Dawnforged. Hard is an initial test difficulty; Rounds practice can run longer than intended.
Physical phone and tablet performance testing of practice matches is still pending.
Prismari currently uses General talents. Its dedicated race talent web will follow.
